title: Modeling Pathology-Like Behavioral Patterns in Language Models Through Behavioral Fine-Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing semantic shifts via next-token probability distribution divergences (Kullback-Leibler and Jensen-Shannon) on open-ended sentence stems using the Rotter Incomplete Sentence Blank (RISB), and measuring the probability mass allocated to depressive choices on the Beck Depression Inventory (BDI).

Analyzing semantic shifts via next-token probability distribution divergences on open-ended sentence stems (RISB), and measuring the probability mass allocated to persecutory and malicious interpretations on the Green et al. Paranoia Scale (GPTS).
